hooks.commandWindows: powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$root = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; $script = Join-Path $root '.gsd-path\guard_hook.py'; if (Get-Command python3 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { & python3 $script } elseif (Get-Command python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { & python $script } else { exit 2 }"
